title: The roadster is revalued
description: The insurer's assessor doubles the agreed value.

title: A transporter is booked
description: Someone books a night pickup for Sunday morning by telephone.

title: The spare key goes out
description: The son signs out the roadster's spare key at the workshop.

title: The garage is armed
description: The owner arms the alarm for the night.

title: A Bentley on the lane
description: A grey Bentley waits on Ashgrove Lane for ten minutes.

title: The alarm is disarmed
description: Someone switches the garage alarm off with a valid code.

title: The roadster rolls down the drive
description: Pushed, not driven, to a transporter waiting on the lane.

title: The alarm is re-armed
description: The same code switches the alarm back on.

title: The empty bay is found
description: The chauffeur arrives for the Sunday polish and raises the alarm.
